## SCS 2.01

Download **SCS.exe** below. It is a single file that needs no install and no Python. Copy your `stratagem_profiles` folder next to it to keep your presets.

SCS.exe is built by GitHub Actions directly from the source of this release and attached a few minutes after publishing. `SCS.exe.sha256` lets you check the download.

### New

- **Stratagem codes from the wiki.** SCS now keeps its stratagem list up to date from the Helldivers 2 wiki (helldivers.wiki.gg). At startup, at most once a day, it adds new stratagems and fixes codes that changed. The result is saved next to the exe, so it keeps working offline, and the built-in list is used if the wiki can't be reached.
- **Stratagem icons.** Icons now show in the stratagem picker and on every slot card on the main page. The current set is built in, and icons for stratagems added later are downloaded from the wiki once.
- **Settings > Stratagem codes.** Shows when the list was last updated, has a switch to turn the daily check off, and an UPDATE NOW button.
- **Search by either name.** When the wiki names a stratagem differently (for example "A/AC-8 Autocannon Sentry"), you can search by either name, and your profiles keep working.
- New stratagems in the list include Cargo Container, Aquifer Drill, Call In Super Destroyer, Portable Comms Relay, Tactical Video Camera and Activate E-711 Extraction Drill.

### Fixes

- SSSD Delivery now uses the correct code from the wiki.
- "CDC-1 One True Flag" is renamed to "CQC-1 One True Flag". Profiles that use the old name still load.

### Network use

The only site SCS contacts is helldivers.wiki.gg, to read public stratagem pages and icons. Nothing about you or your PC is sent, and arming and firing stratagems never use the network. You can turn it off in Settings. `wiki_sync.log` next to the exe records what was downloaded.

Idea for reading codes from the wiki: [goncaloestrelado/HelldiversMacro](https://github.com/goncaloestrelado/HelldiversMacro).
